001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.IIntDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
013import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
014import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
015import org.chocosolver.util.procedure.IntProcedure;
016
017/**
018 * An idempotent and more efficient propagator than the default one. Does not
019 * require an supplementary disjoint propagator like the default one.
020 *
021 * @author jimmy
022 */
023public class PropIntChannel extends Propagator<Variable> {
024
025    private final SetVar[] sets;
026    private final ISetDeltaMonitor[] setsD;
027    private final IntVar[] ints;
028    private final IIntDeltaMonitor[] intsD;
029
030    public PropIntChannel(SetVar[] sets, IntVar[] ints) {
031        super(buildArray(sets, ints), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
032        this.sets = sets;
033        this.setsD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(sets, this);
034        this.ints = ints;
035        this.intsD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(ints, this);
036    }
037
038    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar[] sets, IntVar[] ints) {
039        Variable[] vars = new Variable[sets.length + ints.length];
040        System.arraycopy(sets, 0, vars, 0, sets.length);
041        System.arraycopy(ints, 0, vars, sets.length, ints.length);
042        return vars;
043    }
044
045    private boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
046        return idx < sets.length;
047    }
048
049    private int getSetVarIndex(int idx) {
050        assert isSetVar(idx);
051        return idx;
052    }
053
054    private boolean isIntVar(int idx) {
055        return idx >= sets.length;
056    }
057
058    private int getIntVarIndex(int idx) {
059        assert isIntVar(idx);
060        return idx - sets.length;
061    }
062
063    @Override
064    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
065        for (int i = 0; i < ints.length; i++) {
066            int ub = ints[i].getUB();
067            for (int j = ints[i].getLB(); j <= ub; j = ints[i].nextValue(j)) {
068                if (j < 0 || j >= sets.length || !sets[j].getUB().contains(i)) {
069                    ints[i].removeValue(j, this);
070                }
071            }
072            if (ints[i].isInstantiated()) {
073                sets[ints[i].getValue()].force(i, this);
074            }
075        }
076        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
077            ISetIterator iter = sets[i].getLB().iterator();
078            while (iter.hasNext()) {
079                int j = iter.nextInt();
080                if (j >= 0 && j < ints.length) {
081                    ints[j].instantiateTo(i, this);
082                }
083            }
084        }
085        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
086            ISetIterator iter = sets[i].getUB().iterator();
087            while (iter.hasNext()) {
088                int j = iter.nextInt();
089                if (j < 0 || j >= ints.length || !ints[j].contains(i)) {
090                    sets[i].remove(j, this);
091                }
092            }
093        }
094        PropUtil.startMonitoring(setsD);
095        PropUtil.startMonitoring(intsD);
096    }
097
098    @Override
099    public void propagate(final int idxVarInProp, final int mask) throws ContradictionException {
100        if (isSetVar(idxVarInProp)) {
101            final int id = getSetVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
102
103            setsD[id].forEach(setKer -> {
104                ints[setKer].instantiateTo(id, this);
105                for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
106                    if (i != id) {
107                        sets[i].remove(setKer, this);
108                    }
109                }
110            }, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
111            setsD[id].forEach(setEnv -> {
112                if (ints[setEnv].removeValue(id, this) && ints[setEnv].isInstantiated()) {
113                    int val = ints[setEnv].getValue();
114                    sets[val].force(setEnv, this);
115                    for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
116                        if (i != val) {
117                            sets[i].remove(setEnv, this);
118                        }
119                    }
120                }
121            }, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
122        } else {
123            assert isIntVar(idxVarInProp);
124            final int id = getIntVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
125
126            intsD[id].forEachRemVal((IntProcedure) intRem -> {
127                sets[intRem].remove(id, this);
128            });
129            if (ints[id].isInstantiated()) {
130                sets[ints[id].getValue()].force(id, this);
131            }
132        }
133    }
134
135    @Override
136    public ESat isEntailed() {
137        for (int i = 0; i < ints.length; i++) {
138            if (ints[i].isInstantiated()) {
139                int value = ints[i].getValue();
140                if (value < 0 || value >= sets.length || !sets[value].getUB().contains(i)) {
141                    return ESat.FALSE;
142                }
143            }
144        }
145        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
146            ISetIterator iter = sets[i].getLB().iterator();
147            while(iter.hasNext()) {
148                int j = iter.nextInt();
149                if (j < 0 || j >= ints.length || !ints[j].contains(i)) {
150                    return ESat.FALSE;
151                }
152            }
153        }
154        return isCompletelyInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
155    }
156
157    @Override
158    public String toString() {
159        return "intChannel(" + Arrays.toString(sets) + ", " + Arrays.toString(ints) + ")";
160    }
161}
